# Agent-memo prefixes used by the OLD comment-checker binary
# (OLD_BINARY, sha256 prefix 44ef2b13, version 0.6.1) for its "AGENT MEMO COMMENT DETECTED" block.
# Frozen copy consumed by src/shared/comment-scan/allow-list.ts.
#
# binary: $OLD_BINARY
# binary-sha256: 44ef2b13b68bf795848f957a435302a6a1152f65cdd74dc568fd3cce63310c09
#
# extraction command (strings + grep, run against the installed binary):
#   strings -n 3 $OLD_BINARY \
#     | grep -oE '\(\?i\)\^\[\\s#/\*-\]\*[a-z][^\\]*' | sort -u
# multi-branch regexes and the arrow shape were confirmed with:
#   rg -a -o '\(\?i\)\^\[\\s#/*-\]\*[ -~]{0,60}' \
#     $OLD_BINARY | sort -u
#
# The binary compiles 23 anchored English regexes plus one arrow-shape regex (24 total),
# comment body after stripping leading [space # / * -] characters:
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*added?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*removed?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*deleted?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*note:\s*\w
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*replaced?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*here\s+we\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*previously\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*implemented?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*after\s+this\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*before\s+this\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*was\s+changed\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*refactor(ed|ing)?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*moved?\s+(from|to)\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*now\s+(we|this|it)\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*[a-z]+\s*->\s*[a-z]+      (arrow shape - no literal prefix)
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*changed?\s+(from|to)\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*updated?\s+(from|to)?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*renamed?\s+(from|to)?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*switched?\s+(from|to)\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*modified?\s+(from|to)?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*converted?\s+(from|to)\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*migrated?\s+(from|to)?\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*implementation\s+(of|note)\b
#   (?i)^[\s#/*-]*this\s+(implements?|adds?|removes?|changes?|fixes?)\b
#
# The list below reduces those regexes to the shortest literal prefix that reproduces
# the binary's behaviour under case-insensitive startsWith() matching:
#   - an optional `d` is subsumed by the bare stem ("remove" covers "removed")
#   - a required `(from|to)` needs one line per branch ("switched from", "switched to")
#   - "implemented"/"added" need the `d` because the stem form ("implemente"/"adde")
#     is not a word, and bare "add"/"implement" do NOT match the binary
#   - `note:` requires a following word character ("note:" alone does not match)
# Every line was confirmed by running the binary on a `# <prefix> x` comment body.
#
# Korean stems the same detector also uses (out of scope for the English set):
#   리팩(터|토)링 | 이전(에는|엔) | 여기(서|에서)\s* | 기존(에는|엔|의) | 에서\s+\S+\s*(으로|로)\b
#
added
remove
delete
note:
replace
here we
previously
implemented
after this
before this
was changed
refactor
move from
move to
now we
now this
now it
change from
change to
update
rename
switched from
switched to
modified
converted from
converted to
migrate
implementation of
implementation note
this implements
this adds
this removes
this changes
this fixes
